args.message: I can't answer this from monthly_rev. That summary adds up order amounts by month (sum of orders.amount, grouped by calendar month), so January 2025 is stored as a single row and the daily detail is gone. When I asked it for a daily breakdown, the query failed with an error saying a month-level column can't be split into days. To get revenue per day for January 2025, the breakdown would have to come from the underlying orders table (sum of amount by day of order_date, for 2025-01-01 to 2025-01-31). I didn't run that query.
